text: {"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["bakbakcixan (carnal lust / lewdness)", "û pectzil (the fame/report [of his evil ways])"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["nor will sorrow/repentance ripen in your heart -> and you will find no time in your heart", "it pained my soul greatly that men should be lost -> had great love in my heart for lost mankind"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["lay tun û yicine (then his younger brother)", "hehuac cħaaba bin tac û Kinil (but take care, its day will come)", "tan úpactic û xotol û kin (waiting for the end of his days)", "bul (gambling)"], "added": ["in a dream", "within himself", "Who are you?", "and died"], "mistranslated": ["nor did he waste days -> or days passed", "thus spreading the reputation of his evil ways -> so that the evil of his way was twisted", "began to warn him -> then went out, speaking", "I see you scorn my words -> I see you reflecting on my words", "however much I warn you -> though I say to you, hear", "because you harden your heart against God the Holy Spirit -> when you strengthen your heart toward God the Holy Spirit", "saying these words to him, he left him -> who speaks these words that he raised", "on his bed -> brought here", "he would not merit forgiveness of sins -> and he was terrified", "he saw enter into his room -> he waited to enter into his sleep", "he answered him -> He answered me", "you scorn the good word of God -> as you ponder the sweet word of God", "he vanished, then he remained -> the sick man shook himself and sat up", "garment/covering of thorns -> in torn garments", "from his breast -> at his side", "he asked him whether he knew him -> who asked him: 'Do you know me?'", "because I took pity -> For love of your poverty"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Translation A is an accurate and complete rendering with only minor omissions and lexical slips, while Translation B drops essential clauses, confuses subjects, and repeatedly inverts the meaning of key passages."}
